source: Claremont Competitors Programming 19–25 Oct 26; CFC Fortnightly Fulls WL block wk 2/9; CFC Endurance 19–25 Oct 26
focus: WL comp peak (12 Dec): WL block wk 2/9
Strict MUs Thu + HSPU skill Sun
decisions: Block plan (Josh, 19 Oct): until the 12 Dec weightlifting comp, the WL block is the priority. Rowing is S1 + S2 a week, there's no running, and POLP follows the class programming. Thursday's strict ring muscle-ups stay, and there's one separate HSPU skill session a week.

HSPU skill goes Sunday at open gym (strict HSPU EMOM 8 min × 3, stopping if a rep slows). Every other day is next to pressing: Tue is the day before the POLP press, and Fri sits between Thu bench and Sat jerks. Sunday is furthest from both, at the cost of a little of the rest day.

Rowing restarts at W1, not the class's W6, because nothing was rowed last week. Row S1 replaces Tue Concept Golf (both are machine intervals). Row S2 is an easy 30 min after Sat WL. S3 and the Thu comp-class row are skipped.
Friday is a full rest day now that the run is dropped.
Pressing load: Wed press, Thu HSPU eccentrics + bench, Sat jerks, Sun HSPU EMOM. If the shoulder is niggly Thursday, cut the eccentrics before the bench. If it's niggly Sunday, do holds only.

POLP (as the class schedules it): Mon back squat 140 (repeat after last week's fail), Wed deadlift wk2 + press Phase 2, Thu bench wk5 94 (wk4 was 10/10/10). Max 2 a day; bench and press on different days.
Saturday front squat follows the class (pause FS 4×5 @ 84). POLP front squat stays unstarted (Josh, 18 Oct).
Extra squatting: a front squat accessory block Wed PM (zombie FS, Bulgarian split squat, Spanish squat holds). Wed is two days from both Mon and Sat squats, and the WL deadlift is a hinge.
Mon and Wed class metcons: half reps at 60–70% (Jason's 'strength focus' note). Wed Performance part A is skipped because the deadlift is done in WL. Tue Comp Extras and Sat Performance are skipped.
Sat pause jerk behind the neck is off the split jerk 1RM (124), assuming you split it.

About 20 minutes, the week's one HSPU session.
